text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Public Enterprise Minister Atef Obeid tells al-Ahram there are 950,000 Egyptian investors on the bourse and that share prices have risen by 600 percent. Ministry report shows that 76 public sector companies have been privatised so far.
- Messages from Mubarak to six African leaders to be delivered by foreign minister during African trip.
- State Security in big blow against leaders and members of al-Gama'a al-Islamiyah (Islamic Group) -- 13 terrorists killed and 100 arrested in Minya during a series of operations.
- Government orders 12-month freeze on licenses for buildings to be built overlooking Nile and gives a year for owners of illegal sites to remove them.
- President orders free medical treatment for victims of Heliopolis shopping centre fire.
- Health minister calls for extra duties on cigarettes and tobacco products and for resulting money to be used to treat smoking-related illnesses.
